name: copilot-slides
description: Create, edit, present and export local slide decks in a Copilot canvas. Copilot builds decks from your notes and files with revision-safe edits; you can fine-tune text, shapes, tables, charts and speaker notes by hand, present with a presenter view, import PowerPoint files, and export to HTML, PNG, PDF and PowerPoint. Everything stays on your machine. English and Japanese interface.
